name: Child Benefit
summary: $95 a month for each child under 16.

clauses.CB-1: A household is eligible for each child under the age of 16 who lives in the household.
clauses.CB-2: The payment is $95 per eligible child per month.

name: New Mother and Baby Grant
summary: $600 one-off payment for a new baby, household income under $45,000.

clauses.NMG-1: A household is eligible where a child was born within the last 90 days.
clauses.NMG-2: Annual household income must be below $45,000.
clauses.NMG-3: The grant is a one-off payment of $600 per child born.

name: Jobseeker Allowance
summary: $1,150 a month for up to 9 months for people aged 18 to 65 who lost work.

clauses.JSA-1: The applicant must be aged 18 to 65 and currently unemployed.
clauses.JSA-2: The applicant's employment must have ended within the last 12 months.
clauses.JSA-3: Annual household income from all other sources must be below $40,000.
clauses.JSA-5: The payment is $1,150 per month for up to 9 months.

name: Housing Support Benefit
summary: Up to $400 a month for private renters paying over 30% of income in rent.

clauses.HSB-1: The household must rent its home privately (social housing tenants are not eligible).
clauses.HSB-2: Annual household income must be below $40,000.
clauses.HSB-3: Annual rent must be more than 30% of annual household income.
clauses.HSB-4: The payment is the monthly rent above 30% of monthly income, capped at $400 per month.

name: Carer Allowance
summary: $320 a month for people giving 20+ hours of care a week.

clauses.CAR-1: The applicant must provide at least 20 hours of care per week to a person with a disability or long-term illness.

documents: Statement from the cared-for person's doctor

name: Disability Support Payment
summary: $1,250 a month; needs a medical assessment by an assessor.

clauses.DSP-1: The applicant must be unable to work 15 or more hours a week for at least 6 months because of a disability or illness.
clauses.DSP-2: Eligibility is decided only after an independent medical assessment.

name: Age Pension
summary: $1,050 a month from age 66, income under $30,000 single or $45,000 couple.

clauses.AGP-1: The applicant must be aged 66 or over.
clauses.AGP-2: Annual household income must be below $30,000 for a single person or $45,000 for a couple.

name: Bereavement Support Payment
summary: $2,500 one-off, plus $350 a month for 12 months with children under 16.

clauses.BSP-1: The applicant's spouse or partner must have died within the last 12 months.
clauses.BSP-3: A one-off payment of $2,500 is made.
clauses.BSP-4: Where the applicant has a child under 16, an additional $350 per month is paid for 12 months.

name: Winter Energy Assistance
summary: $250 a year for low-income households or people on JSA, DSP or Age Pension.

clauses.ESA-1: A household is eligible if annual household income is below $28,000.
clauses.ESA-2: A household is also eligible if anyone in it receives or is eligible for Jobseeker Allowance or Age Pension.

name: School Meals and Uniform Support
summary: $300 a year per child aged 5 to 17, income under $35,000.

clauses.SCH-1: A household is eligible for each child aged 5 to 17.
clauses.SCH-2: Annual household income must be below $35,000.
clauses.SCH-3: The payment is $300 per eligible child per year.

name: Childcare Subsidy
summary: 60% of childcare fees for children under 6 where all adults work, income under $90,000.

clauses.CCS-1: A household is eligible where it has a child under 6.
clauses.CCS-2: Every adult in the household must be employed.
clauses.CCS-3: Annual household income must be below $90,000.
clauses.CCS-4: The subsidy is 60% of monthly childcare fees, capped at $900 per month.

name: Emergency Hardship Grant
summary: Discretionary one-off help in a crisis; a caseworker decides.

clauses.EHG-1: A caseworker may award up to $1,000 where a household faces an immediate crisis such as eviction, utilities being cut off or no money for food.
clauses.EHG-2: Awards are at the caseworker's discretion and are never automatic.
